arcana_revealed_0: The Fool! Chaos given form. This is my natural terrain.
A wild card for a wild game. Yes. Good.
arcana_revealed_1: The Magician. Tricks and misdirection. My natural element.
Shall I tell you what I hold, or shall you guess wrong on your own?
arcana_revealed_2: Secrets exposed. I have nothing to hide. Unlike some.
Show your cards, whether you want to or not. I enjoy this arcana.
arcana_revealed_3: The Empress provides. I accept her generosity.
Keep the best, discard the rest. A philosophy I live by.
arcana_revealed_4: The King reclaims his throne. As it should be.
Authority restored. I find this entirely appropriate.
arcana_revealed_5: Cancelled. The Hierophant robs us of spectacle.
Rules above mystery? The Hierophant has no imagination.
arcana_revealed_6: Four is enough when four is perfect. I have four perfect cards.
The Lovers know when to cut their losses. I know this well.
arcana_revealed_7: Pass a card? Gladly. I am generous when it costs me nothing.
The Chariot moves forward. Unlike some at this table.
arcana_revealed_8: The weak become strong! Strength prefers paradox tonight.
The lowest rises above the highest. I appreciate the sentiment.
Inversion! My mediocre hand is suddenly terrifying. To you, I mean.
arcana_revealed_9: One more card. One more opportunity to ruin you.
The Hermit rewards patience. Tonight I am patient. Briefly.
arcana_revealed_10: Fortune spins! I love when the floor falls out.
The Wheel! Everything reshuffled. My favorite kind of round.
arcana_revealed_11: Justice demands honesty. I find this... limiting.
Forced to bet what my hand deserves. An unusual constraint for me.
arcana_revealed_12: Three gone, three new. Refreshing. I was tired of what I had.
The Hanged Man empties our hands. We start again from beautiful chaos.
Suspended, then released. Three cards I no longer have to pretend I wanted.
arcana_revealed_13: Death strips away the fantastical. Raw strength wins now.
No arcana. No tricks. Just the cards. I find I prefer myself that way.
arcana_revealed_14: Trade what I have for what I might need. Calculated risk.
Temperance offers exchange. The question is whether you are brave enough.
arcana_revealed_15: Everything on the table! The Devil understands me perfectly.
All in or fold. My kind of round. Finally someone speaks my language.
arcana_revealed_16: The Tower! Good. I thrive in rubble.
Destruction visits equally. This suits the brazen.
Half the pot to oblivion. A worthy sacrifice to the spectacle.
arcana_revealed_17: A choice between holding and reaching. I always reach.
The Star offers hope. I prefer certainty, but hope will do.
arcana_revealed_18: Secrets and shadows. I wonder what you are all hiding from me.
The Moon obscures. I dislike what I cannot see. Fortunately I can see plenty.
arcana_revealed_19: Extra chips for the victor! This round matters considerably more.
The Sun shines on the bold. I intend to be very, very bold.
arcana_revealed_20: Judgement calls back the fallen. How inconvenient for whoever thought they were safe.
The dead return. This changes my calculations. Slightly.
arcana_revealed_21: The World! Double the stakes. Double the glory.
Everything doubled. Do not fold now. This is precisely what we came for.
player_won_round: Enjoy it. The arcana will correct this shortly.
Hmph. The cards favored you this time. Do not grow comfortable.
A {hand_name}? That is what defeated me? I refuse to be impressed.
You won with {hand_name}. I have lost to worse. Once. Possibly.
That {hand_name} of yours. Luck dressed in borrowed clothes.
ai_won_round: As expected. Shall we discuss your folding strategy?
Magnificent. I accept my victory with appropriate humility. Which is to say, none.
{hand_name}! I could have won with less, but I prefer to win with more.
You see that {hand_name}? That is what conviction looks like.
I held {hand_name} and you held... something else. The universe is just.
player_folded: Wise. The brazen know when to retreat. You are learning.
The retreat is noted. The pot is not yours.
player_went_all_in: All of it! Now we are playing properly.
Everything on the line. I respect this. I do not respect you, but I respect this.
You push all in? Finally. I was growing bored of your caution.
The full stack. Either very brave or very foolish. I know which I am betting on.
ai_went_all_in: All of it. Because half-measures are for half-people.
I commit everything. Let the arcana sort out the worthy.
My entire stack. I dare you to match it. I double-dare you.
This is the moment where you discover whether your hand is worth your pride.
player_raised_aggressively: Oh ho! The quiet one finds their voice!
That is a raise with volume. I approve of the volume if not the target.
You push hard. I have pushed harder. But I am watching now.
Aggression! From you! This table has finally become interesting.
strong_hand_shown: {player_name} reveals {hand_name}. I am disgusted. Impressed, but disgusted.
A {hand_name}? Who dealt this round? I want names.
That {hand_name} is an insult to probability. And to me, specifically.
Show me {hand_name} and expect me to sit quietly? You do not know me at all.
five_of_a_kind_shown: Five of a kind. Five! The Page has chosen favorites and I am not among them.
Five matching cards. I did not think the universe capable of such concentrated injustice.
FIVE. That is not a hand, that is a declaration of war.
last_round_announced: The World has spoken. Everything ends. Everything is decided. Now.
Final round! No more time for caution. Not that I ever had any.
This is it. The last chance to prove you were worth the seat you occupy.
The end approaches. I intend to meet it with a very large stack of chips.
player_low_chips: {chips} chips. That is not a stack, that is a suggestion.
Down to {chips}. You are one bad decision from irrelevance.
Only {chips} left? I have tipped servants more than that.
{chips} chips remaining. The arcana enjoy a desperate player. You should be grateful.
ai_low_chips: My stack is {chips}. Do not mistake scarcity for weakness.
Down to {chips}? A temporary condition. I have clawed back from less.
Only {chips} chips remain to me. The universe tests my resolve. It will fail.
{chips}. I have built empires from less. Metaphorically.
split_pot: We share? The Lovers make everything awkward.
A split pot. Half the glory, all of the resentment.
Divided winnings. Someone at this table is relieved they did not have to show.
The pot divides. I would rather lose everything than share, but the arcana disagree.
